mapper.select: SELECT e.*, p.ENTERPRISE_NAME as parentEnterpriseName, p.CREDIT_CODE as parentCreditCode, p.ENTERPRISE_TYPE as parentEnterpriseType, p.LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE as parentLegalRepresentative FROM ENTERPRISE_INFO e LEFT JOIN ENTERPRISE_INFO p ON e.PARENT_ENTERPRISE_ID = p.ENTERPRISE_ID WHERE e.ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId}
